shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json; echo '---'; cat src/App.tsx; echo '---'; cat src/main.tsx; echo '---'; cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -20; echo '---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; echo '---i18n---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n 2>/dev/null || echo 'not installed'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | head -25; echo '---INDEX---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc "find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | xargs ls -la 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; cat package-lock.json | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "git log --oneline -10 2>/dev/null; echo '---HEAD---'; cat .git/HEAD; echo '---refs---'; cat .git/refs/heads/master; echo '---'; git show --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---index---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---Text---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---Text dts---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addComponentKeysets.d.ts; echo '---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addComponentKeysets.js; echo '---existing keysets---'; rg -l 'addComponentKeysets' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components --glob '*.js' | head -50"
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx; echo '--- i18n.ts ---'; cat src/i18n.ts; echo '--- useAppLanguage.ts ---'; cat src/useAppLanguage.ts"
